study type: Cross-sectional analysis of maternal and neonatal samples with retrospective re-analysis of adult postmortem data.
outcome: DNA methylation alterations/changes in maternal T lymphocytes
DNA methylation alterations/changes in neonatal cord blood T lymphocytes
DNA methylation alterations/changes in adult offspring hippocampi
cohort: The study included 38 antepartum pregnant women, 44 neonates from whom cord blood samples were collected, and 62 adult males whose postmortem hippocampal samples were re-analyzed for a history of maternal depression.
finding: DNA methylation changes in offspring associated with maternal depression are detectable at birth in neonatal cord blood T lymphocytes and persist into adulthood in the brains of offspring.
cross-section timing: Antepartum for maternal samples and at birth for neonatal cord blood samples.
